nfb115b11af.headline: UK Police Top up Budget With Proceeds From Sale of Seized BTC
nfb115b11af.summary: A UK police department sold 295 BTC seized from a drug dealer, retaining 18.8% of the proceeds as authorized by the court.
nfb115b11af.why: The sale of seized cryptocurrency by law enforcement reflects growing regulatory and financial implications of crypto assets.

na32adfec6c.headline: Liberia’s biggest palm oil project quits eco-certification body
na32adfec6c.summary: Golden Veroleum, Liberia’s biggest palm oil company, left a global eco-certification group after accusations of expanding onto community lands without consent.
na32adfec6c.why: Palm oil is a major export for Liberia, and certification affects market access and sustainability credentials critical for investors and trade partners.

n584ecec471.summary: At the G20 summit, the US remained firm on tariffs despite calls from the IMF and France to ease trade tensions that are harming global growth.
